verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that brings Statsig into AI clients such as Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. Through it, users can ask questions, explore experiments, and access their Statsig data in natural language (confirmed by probe). The documented scope is mostly querying and exploration, and natural-language input depends on a third-party AI client. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can perform write/management actions (create or modify gates, experiments, rollouts), a native in-product natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.
